questions.text: Tom has 18 oranges. Mary has 17 oranges. How many oranges do they have altogether?
Peter has 24 stickers. Jane has 9 stickers more than him. How many stickers do they have altogether?
Mr Adam has some eggs. He sells 24 eggs in the morning and 10 eggs in the afternoon. He has 25 eggs left. How many eggs does he have at first?
There are 8 boys and 6 girls in class A and 12 students in class B. How many students are there in the two classes?
Peter has some paperclips. He uses 15 of them and gives 6 paperclips to his sister. He has 17 paperclips left. How many paperclips does he have at first?
Tom has 28 balloons. Jim has 23 balloons more than him. How many balloons do they have altogether?
Ann has some apples. She sells 28 apples and has 15 apples left. How many apples does she have at first?
John buys 21 yellow paperclips and 10 more green paperclips than yellow paperclips. Sean buys 15 paperclips more than John. How many paperclips does Sean buy?
There are 11 green balls in a basket. Peter puts 15 orange balls and 21 purple balls into the basket. How many balls are there in the basket altogether?
A florist sells 26 orchids, 32 carnations and 18 roses. How many flowers does she sell altogether?
There are 9 apples in a basket. Another 12 red apples and 16 green apples are put into the basket. How many apples are there altogether?
Jack sells 24 charity tickets. He sells 17 charity tickets fewer than Mary. How many charity tickets do they sell altogether?
A shirt costs $41. A pair of pants costs $12 more than the shirt. How much do the shirt and the pair of pants cost altogether?
A magazine costs $5 more than a book. The magazine costs $9. What is the cost of 3 such books?
Jack has 26 balloons. Linda has 55 balloons. How many more balloons must Jack buy so that he will have the same number of balloons as Linda?
When a number is subtracted from another, the answer is 12. If the bigger number is 17, what is the smaller number?
Mr Cook buys 17 tickets for a concert. He gives 5 tickets to his friends and uses the rest of the tickets to take his family to the concert. How many people are there in Mr Cook's family?
Alice has 23 stamps. She gives her mother 15 stamps. How many stamps does she have in the end?
13 more than a number is 38. What is the number?
There are 72 people at a party. 20 of them are children and the rest are adults. How many more adults than children are there?
There are 38 soldiers in a field. 15 of them wear green uniforms and the rest wear brown uniforms. How many more soldiers wear brown uniforms than green uniforms?
When two numbers are added together, the answer is 30. If one of the numbers is 12, what is the other number?
A watch and a clock cost $68 at a sale. The watch costs $39. How much more does the watch cost than the clock?
Jim has $80. Linda has $36. How much more money does Jim have than Linda?
Mary buys a toaster for $38. She gives the cashier $50. How much change does she get?
Jim has $95. He spends $26 and saves the rest of his money. How much does he save?
There are 8 boy scouts in a group. Each boy scout has 3 badges. How many badges do they have altogether?
Peter drinks 2 glasses of milk a day. How many glasses of milk does he drink in a week?
Alice puts 8 stamps on every page of her stamp album. There are 5 pages in her album. How many stamps does she have altogether?
There are 6 flowers in a bouquet. Betty buys 3 such bouquets. How many flowers does she buy altogether?
Mrs Wood bakes 18 cakes. She puts them equally into 3 boxes. How many cakes are there in each box?
Andrew reads 4 pages of a book a day. How many days will he take to finish reading a 32-page book?
Mr Cook buys a dozen eggs. He puts them equally into 4 bags. How many eggs are there in each bag?
A packet of tomatoes costs $2. Mrs Fay has $10. How many packets of tomatoes can she buy with all her money?
Mrs Drew buys 30 sweets. She gives 12 sweets to her daughter and 15 sweets to her son. How many sweets has she left?
There are 22 flowers in a vase. 9 of them are red, 6 are yellow and the rest are pink. How many pink flowers are there in the vase?
Mrs Jones bakes 35 cookies. There are 8 butter cookies, some chocolate chip cookies and 12 coconut cookies. How many chocolate chip cookies does she bake?
Mrs Drew bakes 16 apple pies and 28 lemon pies on Monday. On Tuesday, she bakes 12 lemon pies. How many more lemon pies than apple pies does she bake in the end?
There are 20 boys and 10 girls in class A. There are 18 boys and 24 girls in class B. How many fewer girls than boys are there in both classes altogether?
There are 34 peanuts and 12 walnuts on a plate. After Tom has eaten some of the nuts, there are 17 nuts left. How many nuts does Tom eat?
Joe has some marbles. He receives 18 marbles from his father and 13 marbles from his brother. He has 40 marbles in the end. How many marbles does he have at first?
When 12 is added to a number, the result is 2 more than 31. What is the number?
A farmer has 34 eggs. He throws away 8 rotten eggs and sells 7 eggs. He keeps the rest. How many more eggs does he keep than sell?
There are 54 pages in a book. Mary reads 13 pages on Monday and 8 pages on Tuesday. How many pages are not read yet?
There are 18 boys and 21 girls in a field. A teacher has 31 balls. She gives each of them a ball. How many children will not have a ball?
Peter scores 45 points in a game. Alex scores 6 points fewer than him. How many points do they score altogether?
There are 26 batteries in a box. Thomas uses 7 batteries for his toy car and 12 batteries for a torch. How many batteries are left in the box?
Jack, Anna and Tom have 70 marbles. Jack has 24 marbles. Anna has 12 marbles more than him. How many marbles does Tom have?
There are 38 roses in a vase. 12 of them are red, 10 are pink and the rest are white. How many white roses are there?
Mr Smith wants to buy 60 pieces of fruit. He buys 18 apples and 19 bananas at the market. How many more pieces of fruit does he need to buy?
There are 26 boys and 15 girls in a class. 17 children wear spectacles. How many children do not wear spectacles?
Mrs Owen has 20 cookies. She gives 7 cookies each to her two friends. How many cookies has she left?
Jane has 35 stickers. She gives 12 stickers to Sam. William gives Jane 13 stickers. How many stickers does Jane have in the end?
There are 45 books on a shelf. 12 of them are English books, 7 are science books and the rest are mathematics books. How many mathematics books are there?
There are 54 pink ribbons in a box. There are 15 fewer red ribbons than pink ribbons in the box. How many ribbons are there altogether?
There are 40 fish in a tank. 16 of them are orange, 11 are red and the rest are white. How many white fish are there?
There are 26 red apples and 12 green apples in box A. There are 20 red apples and 10 green apples in box B. How many more apples are there in box A than in box B?
Joel has some toy cars. His mother gives him 18 toy cars and his father gives him another 8 toy cars. He has 41 toy cars altogether. How many toy cars does he have at first?
Peter has $20. He spends $4 on Monday and $8 on Tuesday. How much has he left?
Tom has 28 toy aeroplanes. 12 of them are red, 5 are green and the rest are blue. How many more blue toy aeroplanes than green toy aeroplanes does he have?
There are 35 adults and 28 children at a party. After 3 men and 17 girls leave the party, how many people are left at the party?
A dinner costs $100. Mr William pays $35, Mr Jackson pays $40 and Mr Lee pays the rest. How much does Mr Lee pay?

There are 80 students in an art competition. 15 of them are in Primary 1, 12 are in Primary 2 and the rest are in Primary 3. What is the total number of Primary 1 and Primary 3 students in the competition?
Ben has $30. He spends $5 on food, $9 on books and some on stationery. He has $8 left. How much does he spend on stationery?
John has $7. Betty has $2 more than John. Peter has $6 less than Betty. How much do they have altogether?
An apple costs 60 cents. An orange costs 20 cents less than the apple. A pear costs 40 cents more than the orange. How much does the pear cost?
A dress costs $24. It costs $16 more than a blouse. What is the total cost of the dress and the blouse?
There are 46 orchids in a vase. There are 28 more orchids than roses in the vase. How many flowers are there altogether?
A photo album contains 24 photographs. Jack takes out 8 photographs and puts in 15 new ones. How many photographs are in the photo album in the end?
There are 14 pink flowers and 12 red flowers in a shop. 7 flowers are sold. How many flowers are left?
There are 3 red pens and 2 blue pens in a box. How many pens are there in 5 such boxes?
Mrs Rice has 3 boxes of cookies. There are 5 cookies in each box. Her friend gives her another 12 cookies. How many cookies does Mrs Rice have altogether?
In a hall, there are 3 rows of children. There are 7 children in each row. Another 5 children arrive at the hall. How many children are there altogether?
There are 4 bags of oranges. Each bag has 8 oranges. There are 3 bags of apples. Each bag has 5 apples. How many pieces of fruit are there altogether?
Mr Baker buys some eggs. He cooks 12 of them, throws away 6 rotten ones and packs the rest into 2 bags. Each bag has 3 eggs. How many eggs does he have at first?
There are 5 blue crayons and 6 purple crayons in a box. There are 3 boxes. How many crayons are there altogether?
Mr Bell has 18 apples. He shares the apples equally with his 2 friends. How many apples does each of them get?
Ben has 8 coins. Lucy has 4 coins. They divide their coins equally between themselves. How many coins does each of them get?
There are 12 chicken eggs and 6 quail eggs in a basket. All the eggs are packed equally into 3 packets. How many eggs are there in each packet?
2 books cost $10 and 3 pens cost $6. How much does Peter spend if he buys a book and a pen?
There are 11 children in a room. 3 of them do not have hats. The rest of the children have 2 hats each. How many hats do they have altogether?
Janet buys 4 packets of balloons. There are 5 balloons in each packet. She uses 2 packets. How many balloons has she left?
Mary has $15. She buys a chocolate cake and has $7 left. How much do 2 such chocolate cakes cost?
Mr Brown has 4 bags. There are 9 oranges in each bag. He gives 15 oranges to his friend. How many oranges has he left?
A stalk of rose costs $5. A florist sells 3 stalks of roses and some stalks of orchids. She collects $27. How much money does she collect from selling the orchids?
2 chairs and a table cost $50. A chair costs $8. What is the cost of the table?
4 children have 5 buns each. Each child eats 2 buns. How many buns are there left?
Mrs Taylor has 10 boxes of egg tarts. There are 4 egg tarts in a box. She gives 6 boxes of egg tarts to her friends. How many egg tarts has Mrs Taylor left?
There are 7 bunches of balloons. Each bunch has 3 balloons. 15 of the balloons are green and the rest are blue. How many blue balloons are there?
A pencil costs 90 cents. An eraser costs 60 cents less. Jim wants to buy 3 erasers. How much does he have to pay?
Peter has $20. He buys a vase for $11. The cashier gives him a five-dollar note and some two-dollar notes in change. How many two-dollar notes does the cashier give him?
Alice packs 12 buns equally into 3 bags. In each bag, there is 1 raisin bun and some butter buns. How many butter buns are there in each bag?
Mary has 12 apples. George has 6 apples. How many apples must Mary give to George so that they have an equal number of apples?
Daniel has 40 stickers. Kate has 22 stickers. How many stickers must Daniel give to Kate so that they have an equal number of stickers?
Peter has 90 cents in his wallet. He has 5 ten-cent coins and some twenty-cent coins. How many twenty-cent coins does he have?
There are 20 marbles in a bag. Sam divides them equally into 4 groups. How many marbles are there in 2 such groups?
There are 6 oranges in a bag. A bag of oranges costs $3. Mrs Cook has $15. How many oranges can she buy altogether?

Mrs Scoff has some cookies. She buys 15 cookies. She has 65 cookies in the end. (a) How many cookies does she have at first? (b) How many cookies does she have altogether if she buys another 25 cookies?
Mr Adam spends $70 on a belt and saves the rest of his money. If he saves $12, (a) how much more does he spend than save? (b) how much money does he have at first?
A plate costs $8 more than a bowl. If the plate costs $23, (a) how much does the bowl cost? (b) what is the total cost of the plate and the bowl?
There are 40 chickens and 13 ducks on a farm. The farmer buys another 14 chickens. (a) How many more chickens than ducks are there on the farm? (b) How many chickens and ducks are there altogether?
